Elevon balance (D-187 v2, D-205, T-077 p8 L): 10.0 g lead strip 20 mm ahead of the hinge (10 x 0.83 mm x 106 mm; T-077 p8 flutter re-run) + 2 PETG/CF tabs 0.5 g (caps are separate parts WNG-008)
Lens cap + stop bosses (R, upper skin): wall 0.6 mm, >= 0.5 mm clearance to the lead at the +-21 deg stop

Hinge damper rotor (R): sleeve + flange bonded on the elevon tip
Hinge damper rotor (L): sleeve + flange bonded on the elevon tip
Hinge damper stator (R): printed housing + pin, 12,500 cSt silicone fluid, 2 silicone preload strips

Wing torsion skin: 1 ply 48 g/m2 glass at +-45 deg wet-laid on the core, closed over the leading edge and the cove face, y -0.40..+0.40, wet ply 0.054 mm (EST) drawn as a shell inside the core outline; openings as the core (slots, pockets, windows); mass = shell volume x 1.63 g/cm3 (88 g/m2 / 0.054 mm, T-071 l.24)
Cove CF strip, section 6 x 0.5 mm = 3 mm2 (only the area is given, T-071 l.32; width, thickness and product -), y -0.40..+0.40, under the skin on the cove face; mass = volume x 1.55 g/cm3

Wing torsion skin plies 2-3 (R, T-077 p8, D-226 / AM-016): 2 more plies of 48 g/m2 glass at +-45 deg wet-laid over ply 1, |y| 0.052..0.400 (the torsion bay between the centre and fin bulkheads plus laps), closed over the LE and the cove face; drawn inside ply 1 (core machined smaller by the total); mass = shell volume x 1.63 g/cm3

Wing torsion skin plies 2-3 (L, T-077 p8, D-226 / AM-016): 2 more plies of 48 g/m2 glass at +-45 deg wet-laid over ply 1, |y| 0.052..0.400 (the torsion bay between the centre and fin bulkheads plus laps), closed over the LE and the cove face; drawn inside ply 1 (core machined smaller by the total); mass = shell volume x 1.63 g/cm3

Centre bulkhead (R, T-077 p8, D-226 s3): 0.5 mm CF sheet (waterjet, BOM T2) cut to the cell inside the 3 skin plies (LE to the cove), y 60.0..60.5 mm, spar hole 12 mm (flox), servo-lead slot and (left) I2C hole; 2-ply 1080 tape lap 8 mm on the skin round the edge; CGE-006 flange bonded on its inboard face. Mass = plate 2.55 g (area x 0.5 mm x 1.6 g/cm3) + tape lap 1.07 g + flange bond line 0.37 g (EST)

Centre bulkhead (L, T-077 p8, D-226 s3): 0.5 mm CF sheet (waterjet, BOM T2) cut to the cell inside the 3 skin plies (LE to the cove), y -60.0..60.5 mm, spar hole 12 mm (flox), servo-lead slot and (left) I2C hole; 2-ply 1080 tape lap 8 mm on the skin round the edge; CGE-006 flange bonded on its inboard face. Mass = plate 2.55 g (area x 0.5 mm x 1.6 g/cm3) + tape lap 1.07 g + flange bond line 0.37 g (EST)

Fin node bulkheads (R, T-077 p8, D-226 s3; replaces the printed rib saddle): two 0.5 mm CF sheet bulkheads (waterjet, BOM T2) at |y| 369.5..370.0 and 396.0..396.5 mm (0.5 mm from the 25 mm rib flanks), cut to the cell inside the 3 skin plies from the LE to x 176, spar holes 12 mm (flox), slotted into the core; rib bonded between them by flox fillets (12 mm wide per flank, EST) over x 70.5..176; 2-ply 1080 tape laps 8 mm on both skins. Mass = plates 5.02 + tape laps 2.07 + flox 2.91 g (EST)

Fin node bulkheads (L, T-077 p8, D-226 s3; replaces the printed rib saddle): two 0.5 mm CF sheet bulkheads (waterjet, BOM T2) at |y| 369.5..370.0 and 396.0..396.5 mm (0.5 mm from the 25 mm rib flanks), cut to the cell inside the 3 skin plies from the LE to x 176, spar holes 12 mm (flox), slotted into the core; rib bonded between them by flox fillets (12 mm wide per flank, EST) over x 70.5..176; 2-ply 1080 tape laps 8 mm on both skins. Mass = plates 5.02 + tape laps 2.07 + flox 2.91 g (EST)
